## 4000 - 4096

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04000">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4000 GQA - Low tert-butylcyclohexane</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04000">

Found as part of the Extended Analysis, this exception is generated when a source’s tert-Butylcyclohexane mole % value exceeds the user defined limit for minimum value for tert-Butylcyclohexane mole %. For example, the minimum limit for tert-Butylcyclohexane mole % is set to 0.1000, but the tert-Butylcyclohexane mole % on the sample is imported at 0.0999.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04085">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4085 GQA - N2 component set to zero and sample re-normalized</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04085">

This exception is generated when the validation “Remove N2 and renormalized when N2 \< \[user specifies amount\]” is enabled and a liquid source analysis is imported with a Nitrogen (N2) amount that is less than the user specified amount but greater than 0 or NULL. N2 will be removed from the source in FLOWCAL and the total source amount will be renormalized. For example, N2 is removed when the following is true:



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 183;height: 236;" />

If a source analysis text file is imported with an N2 mole % = 0.5000, then exception 4085 will be generated and N2 will be removed from the source record:



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 554;height: 510;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04086">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4086 GQA - N2 component not set to zero; above re-normalization limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04086">

This exception is generated when the validation “Remove N2 and renormalize when N2 \< \[user specifies amount\]” is enabled and the liquid source analysis is imported with a Nitrogen (N2) amount that is not 0 or NULL and is greater than the user specified amount. N2 will not be removed from the source in FLOWCAL and the total source amount will not be renormalized. For example, N2 is removed when the following is true:



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 180;height: 232;" />

If a source analysis text file is imported with an N2 mole % = 2.5000, then exception 4086 will be generated and N2 will remain as is in the source record:



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 555;height: 511;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04087">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4087 GQA - Comparison variance</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04087">

An option is available in the Liquid Quality Source Editor to compare a new source (Source B) with a pre-existing source (Source A). When this comparison is established and a source record for Source B is imported into FLOWCAL, Source B’s newest record will be compared to Source A’s most current record. If there is any variance between the two analyses, FLOWCAL will generate exception 4087 on Source B.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 555;height: 468;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04088">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4088 GQA - C6+/C7+ not applied</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04088">

This exception is generated when a source analysis’ Component Configuration Method is configured to “Use C6+ and C7+ Splits” and C6+ Split and C7+ split does not equal 100.000 and the imported or manually entered source record has a value other than 0 for C8, C9, or C10.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 560;height: 363;" />



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 554;height: 511;" />

If only C6+ Split is not equal to 100 but C7+ Split is 100, then this exception will be generated if the source record has a value other than 0 for C7, C8, C9 or C10.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 553;height: 116;" />



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 556;height: 510;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04089">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4089 GQA - Unnormalized total = 0</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04089">

This exception is generated when the Unnormalized Volume Total is equal to 0 or not within the appropriate min/max limits set under Source Validations. This can occur in one of two ways:

- **Upon Import:** If a Source Analysis Text File is imported with a record containing an Unnormalized Total = 0
- **Run Validations:** If the Minimum for Unnormalized Total is something other than “0.000” and source validations are run for a source with an Unnormalized Total = 0

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04090">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4090 GQA - Full wellstream &gt; 1</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04090">

This exception is generated when a GQ source has enabled Fws (Full Wellstream) on the Liq Content subtab under the Source Quality Source Analysis tab and the source quality record has a Full Wellstream factor that is greater than 1.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 555;height: 509;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04091">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4091 GQA - Calculated relative density not within allowed ranges</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04091">

This exception is generated when the following is true:

- Calculated Relative Density is rounded to 4 decimal places
- Calculated Relative Density is not within the following ranges:
  - 0.5000 – 0.5029
  - 0.5030 – 0.5074
  - 0.5075 – 0.5100

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04092">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4092 GQA - Missing shrinkage factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04092">

This exception is generated when the shrink factor on an LQ Source is null. By default, the severity of this exception is 0.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04093">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4093 GQA - Invalid shrinkage factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04093">

This exception is generated when one or both of the following are true for an LQ Source:

- The shrink factor is less than or equal to zero
- The shrink factor is greater than one

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04094">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4094 GQA - Missing flash gas factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04094">

This exception is generated when the flash gas factor on an LQ Source is null. By default, the severity of this exception is 0.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04095">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4095 GQA - Invalid flash gas factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04095">

This exception is generated when the flash gas factor on an LQ Source is less than zero.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04096">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4096 GQA - Flash gas factor must be 0 because shrinkage factor is 1</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04096">

This exception is generated when one of the following is true for an LQ Source:

- The shrink factor is one and the flash gas factor is not zero or null
- The shrink factor is null and the flash gas factor is not zero or null

</div>

</div>
